_comment: Cross-language vectors for the two secret scanners: agent/src/output_scanner.py (tool output) and cdk/src/handlers/shared/deny-reason-scanner.ts (deny reasons). Both test suites (agent/tests/test_output_scanner.py, cdk/test/handlers/shared/deny-reason-scanner.test.ts) run every vector, so the pattern for a URL with a user and a password cannot change in one scanner alone. 'expected' is the text after the scan; where it equals 'input', the scanners leave the text as it is. A URL without a password is replaced as well when a port follows its host and the first '@' behind the port begins no path segment: the scanners cannot tell it from a URL with a password. Only shapes that both scanners replace by the same marker belong here. Every value is made up; the AWS key id is the example of the AWS documentation.
